verdict.rationale: Granola's docs say users can pick a specific template, or create their own, for particular call types such as 1:1s, interviews and sales pitches, instead of relying on the default summarisation. Recipes add reusable saved prompt templates for getting insights from notes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on how custom templates are authored or automatically applied per meeting type (e.g., standups).
